description: Deliberately grants the webview no tauri-plugin-dialog permission. The plugin's own commands (open / save / message) would let any script in the WebView raise a file dialog and learn a path, or be handed one, without the profile feature deciding anything. The two dialogs this app has are opened from the commands in src-tauri/src/profile_files.rs — application commands, outside this ACL — which validate the path the user chose before a byte is written, and answer "nothing happened" when the user closes the window. Same shape and same reasoning as app-update.json. JSON rather than YAML because the .yaml files in this directory are capability recipes, read by scripts/validate-catalog.mjs, and this is a Tauri ACL entry.
